
```{r}
library(TwoSampleMR)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)
library(data.table)
hba1cins <- read.xlsx("data\\hba1c.xlsx")
refbio <- fread("data\\mse.txt.gz")
library(tidyverse)

```

 
```{r}

hba1c_clumped <- format_data(hba1cins,
                          type = "exposure",
                          effect_allele_col = "A1",
                          beta_col = "BETA",
                          se_col = "SE",
                          other_allele_col = "A2",
                          pval_col = "P",
                          eaf_col = "EAF")

hba1c_data <- clump_data(hba1c_clumped, clump_r2 = 0.001)
```



```{r}
refractive_data <- merge(refbio,
                         hba1c_data,
                         by="SNP")

refractive_data <- unique(refractive_data)
```



```{r}
refractive_data <- data.frame(refractive_data)
ref_clumped <- format_data(refractive_data,
                           type = "outcome",
                           effect_allele_col = "EA",
                           beta_col = "BETA",
                           se_col = "SE",
                           other_allele_col = "NEA",
                           pval_col = "P",
                           eaf_col = "EAF")
```


```{r}
harmonised_hba1c_ref <- harmonise_data(exposure_dat = hba1c_data,
                                    outcome_dat = ref_clumped)
```


```{r}
F <- 
  harmonised_hba1c_ref$beta.exposure^2/harmonised_hba1c_ref$se.exposure^2
mF <- mean(F)
mF
```

```{r}
mr_hba1c_ref <- mr(harmonised_hba1c_ref, 
                method_list = "mr_ivw")
mr_hba1c_ref
```

```{r}
mr_scatter_plot(mr_hba1c_ref, harmonised_hba1c_ref)
```



```{r}
mr_heterogeneity(harmonised_hba1c_ref)
```


```{r}
mr_hba1c_ref_egg <-  mr(harmonised_hba1c_ref, 
                     method_list = "mr_egger_regression")
mr_hba1c_ref_egg

mr_hba1c_egg_int <- mr_pleiotropy_test(harmonised_hba1c_ref)

mr_hba1c_egg_int

```


```{r}
mr_scatter_plot(mr_hba1c_ref_egg, harmonised_hba1c_ref)
```


```{r}
mr_hba1c_ref_wm <-  mr(harmonised_hba1c_ref,

mr_hba1c_ref_wm
```


```{r}
mr_scatter_plot(mr_hba1c_ref_wm, harmonised_hba1c_ref)
```
